answer_1.quote: We include LaMP-4 (news headline generation) and LaMP-5 (scholarly title generation) ... We also include a public LLM personalization benchmark, LaMP, offering a testbed for all aforementioned tasks ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated replies, titles, headlines, and ranking of candidate responses

answer_2.quote: For our CMV benchmark, considering it is a ranking task, we adopt Hit@1, Hit@3, DCG@3 and MRR. For LaMP, we follow the official metrics, and use accuracy and F1-score for classification tasks ... and ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L for text generation tasks.
